lines.en: If you build it, he will come.
lines.note: （核证证据：IMDb Quotes https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0097351/quotes/ （The Voice: "If you build it, he will come."）；Wikiquote https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Field_of_Dreams 收录同一逐字句（AFI 百年百大台词第 39 位，注意原文为 he 而非讹传的 they，多源确证））

lines.text: 人们会来的，雷。他们会来艾奥瓦，理由连他们自己也说不清。他们会在你家车道口拐进来，并不确知自己为什么要来。
lines.en: Ray, people will come Ray. They'll come to Iowa for reasons they can't even fathom. They'll turn up your driveway not knowing for sure why they're doing it.
lines.note: （核证证据：IMDb Quotes https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0097351/quotes/ （搜索快照逐字："Ray, people will come Ray. They'll come to Iowa for reasons they can't even fathom. They'll turn up your driveway not knowing for sure why they're doing it."）；Wikiquote https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Field_of_Dreams （"Oh... people will come Ray. People will most definitely come."））

lines.text: 这是——这是天堂吗？／是——是艾奥瓦。／我还以为这是天堂呢。
lines.en: Is, is this heaven? / It's — it's Iowa. / I could have sworn it was heaven.
lines.character: 约翰·金塞拉 / 雷·金塞拉
lines.note: （核证证据：Wikiquote https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Field_of_Dreams （结尾父子对话逐字："John Kinsella: Is, is this heaven? Ray Kinsella: It's — it's Iowa. John Kinsella: I could have sworn it was heaven."）；IMDb Quotes https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0097351/quotes/ （"John Kinsella: Is this heaven? Ray Kinsella: It's Iowa. John Kinsella: Iowa? I could have sworn this was heaven."。注：通行流传的归属 Shoeless Joe 的 "No, it's Iowa" 为讹传））
